extract_captions_from_logs: extract captions from log.txt files in a folder tree and return a dict mapping sample IDs to captions
run_video_captioning_evaluation: run video captioning evaluation by extracting captions from output logs and scoring them against MSRVTT reference annotations
build_reference_dict_from_annotations: build a reference dictionary from an MSRVTT annotation JSON file mapping video IDs to their caption lists
review_extract_captions: review the extract_captions function that parses log.txt files and extracts captions by line index
summarize_video_captioning_eval: summarize the video captioning evaluation pipeline that uses EvalCap to score generated captions against references
